decisions.reason: The cleaning soap builds directly on the firm's surface-treatment know-how and complements its core floors, so it is cheap to keep and easy to refine from customer feedback.
The maintenance oil line rests on the firm's own surface-treatment R&D and strengthens aftersales ties with installers and homeowners, giving it strong absorptive capacity.
Care products for oiled floors fit the firm's oiled finishes closely, so its existing knowledge lets it interpret results and improve the line.

Foam underlay sits further from the wood-processing core and the related moisture-protection underlay has already been withdrawn, but it remains a low-cost standard system accessory worth keeping for now.
The oak parquet line is the heart of the firm's wood-processing expertise and production base, where its knowledge for further development is strongest.
